connection: OPERATOR_SQL_READONLY_DATABASE_URL — dedicated read-only login role on the Aurora READER endpoint (owner-provisioned); never AURORA_DATABASE_URL (vitana_admin) or AURORA_RLS_DATABASE_URL (authenticator); unset -> not_configured

input.sql: one SELECT / WITH … SELECT / plain EXPLAIN (required, <=4000 chars)

pool.ssl: resolveAuroraSsl() — same TLS resolution as aurora-client.ts

audit: gateway log line [VTID-04023] dev_run_sql_readonly thread=… fp=… kind=… rows=… ms=… (readable via dev_cloudwatch_logs)
failure_posture: validation refusal and Postgres errors returned verbatim as `Read-only SQL failed: …`; never an empty result
